writeup: Woot has the ELLE Wayfarer 23L backpack in olive green, new, for $31.99. It holds a 15.6-inch laptop and has a trolley sleeve for sliding over a suitcase handle. ELLE's own store and House of Zazla both sell the same olive variant for $59.99, so this is about 46% less. Woot limits it to 3 per order.
